# Leo Brennan — Profile as of 2026-03-05 20:15

## Basics
- Leo Brennan lives in Chicago with his partner, Sam Rivera. Leo turned 33 on October 30, 2025.
- Leo and Sam celebrated their 5-year anniversary on Thursday in September 2025 with the tasting menu at Marigold Room. Sam gave Leo a framed periodic-table print in his own hand lettering.
- Leo is a chemistry teacher, science club adviser, runner and sourdough baker.

## Home and commuting
- Leo and Sam moved on February 21, 2026, to a dog-friendly two-bedroom in Avondale. Address: 2240 N Kestrel Ave, Apt 2.
- The apartment is on the second floor and has a back porch that gets the morning sun. They bought a used dining table from a neighbor for $80.
- Leo's commute is now a 25-minute bike ride; Sam's is 10 minutes. This replaces Leo's previous Blue Line plus a ten-minute walk, Forty minutes door to door.
- Their previous lease did not allow dogs. Their new apartment does, but Leo says they will not get a dog until after the race in April. Sam has already chosen the name Pickle; no dog has been adopted.

## Family and close people
- Sam Rivera is Leo's partner and a senior designer at Northpaw Studio, promoted in November 2025. He completed bakery branding featuring a croissant with little legs as the logo.
- Sam likes design, fonts, vintage objects and photography. Leo gave him a vintage film camera for his birthday on Saturday the 7th in February; he loved it and immediately shot a whole roll of the cat next door. He also loved the drafting lamp Leo gave him for Christmas.
- Sam cooks; notable meals include frittata, birthday lasagna, a beaker-shaped cake and hangover pancakes.
- Leo's mother is Joan and his father is Mike. Mike retired after 34 years at the water utility. Joan organized his retirement party on Saturday December 13 in Milwaukee, at the VFW hall. There were 80 people, Joan made a slideshow, and Leo cried during his own speech.
- Mike began a woodworking class and has now finished a crib for his granddaughter. On March 3, Leo said it was beautiful; Hana cried and Alex pretended not to.
- Leo's brother Alex and Hana are expecting a baby girl, due April 20. They announced the pregnancy at Mike's retirement party. Alex and Hana helped Leo and Sam move.
- Alex and Hana's baby shower is Saturday March 14, 2 pm, at Hana's parents' house in Evanston. It is co-ed.
- Alex Moreau is a separate friend who hosts game nights and the regular New Year's Eve party. His next game night is Saturday March 7. Maddie misses the game nights and wants a trivia rematch with him.
- Rosa Duarte is Leo's department head. Principal Hughes also supports his graduate-school application.

## Work and education
- Leo teaches at Ashby High. The school year began August 25; this is his first year teaching AP Chemistry. He teaches one AP section and three regular chemistry sections and continues advising science club.
- His AP Chemistry class has 28 students. Priyanka found a typo in his syllabus on day two and scored a 5 on the February 3 mock exam; the class average was 3.4 out of 5.
- Rosa Duarte gave Leo her old AP lab binder.
- Science club had Twelve students sign up, double the previous year. Its water reclamation plant trip was moved to October 24 because the bus fell through; Mike was to attend as a guest expert.
- Leo coordinated the February 12 school science fair, with 42 projects. One of his teams earned a spot at regionals with water filtration using sand and charcoal. Rosa bought the department pizza afterward.
- Leo applied to the MEd in Science Education at Lakemont University: part-time, evenings, Two years, so he can keep teaching. He submitted the application on Wednesday before January 18, ahead of the January 15 deadline.
- Maddie edited his personal statement. Rosa and Principal Hughes wrote recommendations; Hughes described Leo as 'relentlessly curious'.
- Leo completed his in-person interview at Lakemont on February 25, 4 pm. He thought it went well; they asked a lot about the science fair. A decision is expected by March 13.

## Health and running
- Leo is registered for the Prairie Lights Half Marathon on April 19: Lakefront to the Riverwalk, 13.1 miles.
- Renee Walsh at Kinetic Way PT diagnosed IT band syndrome after Leo developed pain on the outside of his knee during long runs.
- Renee initially capped long runs at 6 miles, with increases of no more than one mile per week afterward. His exercises are daily foam rolling and clamshells.
- Renee discharged him from PT at his last session on January 28. He should continue the exercises.
- Latest running update: Leo completed his first 10-miler on February 28 and his knee was totally fine. This supersedes earlier reports of pain after about 6 miles.

## Interests, possessions and preferences
- Leo's sourdough starter is named Gus. Gus survived the move in a cooler and now lives on top of the fridge, thriving.
- Leo has baked regular sourdough and cinnamon raisin bread. He also made gluten-free bread for Grace.
- Maddie gave Leo a twelve-inch cast-iron pan for Christmas. He seasoned it twice and is taking it on the cabin trip with his sourdough.
- Leo owns a signed copy of The Salt Orchard, signed by Imogen Vale at the book fair two years before October 2025. Maddie borrowed it in October, accidentally packed it during her move and still had not returned it as of February 25. It is by her front door next to her keys; she has promised to mail it back.
- Maddie made Leo a green pottery mug with a wonky handle. It had not arrived as of March 3; tracking said Thursday.
- Maddie recommended the podcast Lamplight Hours, interviews with people who work night shifts. She particularly liked the bridge operator episode and advised giving it three episodes.
- Leo and Sam spent four days in Door County in summer 2025 and ate cherry pie every day.

## Maddie Cho — friendship, contact and home
- Maddie Cho is a close friend of Leo and Sam. She moved from Chicago to Denver with her father Paul and her dog Juniper, arriving Saturday night before January 5 after 14 hours of driving.
- Current address: 1418 Larkspur Ct, Apt 1, Denver, CO 80211.
- Current phone: (720) 555-0164. Her old Chicago number shut off on February 1 and is no longer current.
- She lives in a one-bedroom, ground-floor apartment in Highland. This replaced a planned third-floor walk-up in Baker: that apartment fell through when the landlord sold the building and the new owner planned renovations. The move was consequently delayed from December to January 3; she and Paul drove the rental truck on January 2 and 3.
- Her landlord is Mr. Ortega. Her noisy radiator was repaired on Monday before February 4 and is now quiet.
- Her upstairs neighbor Gloria is a retired music teacher who plays piano at 9 am every day; Maddie enjoys it.
- Maddie sold her couch to coworker Kim for $200. After a $4,000 movers' quote, she and Paul used a rental truck instead.
- She sold her former car before moving and has now bought a used gray hatchback with snow tires.
- Leo helped Maddie pack on December 20. Sam could not help because of his work holiday party.

## Maddie — work, routines and relationships
- Maddie is a pediatric physical therapist at Aspen Lane Children's Therapy in Denver, a pediatric outpatient practice with substantial early intervention work. She started January 12.
- Her boss is Dr. Priscilla Grant, whom she calls the best boss she has ever had. The clinic has a sensory gym and a tiny climbing wall; Maddie's caseload is mostly toddlers.
- She works Monday to Thursday, 7 to 5:30, ten-hour days, with Fridays off.
- She left Lakeview Pediatric Rehab in Chicago after four years; her final day was December 12, with a goodbye lunch. Aspen Lane provided $3,000 for relocation.
- Her coworker Tasha Reid introduced her to Little Kettle Coffee, around the corner from her apartment. Maddie loves its oat latte.
- Maddie takes pottery classes Thursday evenings at Clayhouse Studio and goes climbing Tuesday nights at Basecamp Climbing, which Tasha encouraged her to join.
- Maddie and Ethan became official as of March 1. They met at trivia night. He is a pediatric nurse at one of the hospitals in Denver. Their first date was Saturday before February 8; he also took her to Valentine's dinner. Juni is warming up to him.
- Maddie's birthday is March 12. She wants pottery trimming tools with wooden handles, not the plastic kit; her current tools bend.
- Her favorite ramen is Hoshizora on Milwaukee Avenue in Chicago: spicy miso with an extra egg, every time.

## Maddie — health, family and dog
- Maddie is allergic to cashews and pistachios, confirmed by an allergist after an itchy-throat reaction to pesto at Kim's potluck. She carries an epinephrine pen. Leo bans both nuts from his kitchen when she visits and labels food.
- Maddie is vegetarian and has been since sophomore year of college, twelve years as of November 2025.
- Her parents are Linda and Paul, in Naperville. Paul helped drive her rental truck to Denver and made her promise to get snow tires.
- Linda visited Denver February 20 to 23, brought Korean side dishes, enjoyed Little Kettle, bonded with Juni and completely reorganized Maddie's kitchen.
- Maddie's grandmother Sun-ja is 84 and lives in LA. After breaking her hip and having a hip replacement in November, she is now home: she returned January 16, walks with a cane and does PT twice a week. This replaces the earlier rehab-facility status.
- Maddie's aunt Mi-young helped with Sun-ja's recovery and hosted Thanksgiving. Maddie spent Thanksgiving week in LA helping her aunt.
- Maddie adopted Juniper, called JUNI or Juni, on November 15 from Second Lap Greyhound Rescue. Juni is a retired racing greyhound, four years old at adoption.
- Juni sleeps 18 hours a day, has a sensitive stomach and eats salmon and sweet potato kibble. She fears slippery floors and thunder and was initially unwilling to use stairs. The ground-floor apartment suits her.
- During thunder-snow in February, Juni hid in the bathtub for two hours. A weighted blanket helps her.
- Juni's vet is Dr. Ruth Fenn at Highland Vet Clinic. Leo and Sam gave her a red winter coat for Christmas.
- Leo and Sam dog-sat Juni during Thanksgiving week, with their landlord's permission. Maddie collected her Sunday evening, November 30. Juni bonded strongly with Sam and stole half a loaf of Gus bread during the stay.

## Grace and Daniel — wedding and hosting considerations
- Grace lives in Santa Fe. Daniel teaches welding at the community college there. He proposed at Bandelier at sunrise in July 2025.
- Their wedding is May 16 at Casa Lumbre in Santa Fe, outdoors in the courtyard with old cottonwood trees. This replaces earlier tentative spring/May timing.
- Leo and Sam are invited and intend to attend.
- Wedding RSVPs are due March 15 on the wedding website. Meal choices are vegetarian risotto or trout. Leo promised on February 19 to RSVP that week, but there is no confirmation that he has done so.
- Maddie is maid of honor. The bridal party is just Maddie and Daniel's sister Lucia.
- Maddie is hosting Grace's bridal shower on April 18 in Albuquerque. Theme: 'desert brunch'. She has ordered 40 tiny cactus favors.
- Leo is helping Maddie write a funny and sentimental wedding toast. On March 3, he advised cutting the second joke about Daniel's welding; Maddie agreed to cut it.
- Daniel has a serious shellfish allergy. Grace has celiac disease and needs gluten-free food. Leo accommodated both when hosting them in September.

## Cabin trip — current arrangements and money owed
- Leo and Maddie's Elk Hollow cabin trip is now March 27 to 29. It was moved from February 14 to 16 because a huge snowstorm threatened to close the road. The owner moved the booking at no charge and carried over the deposit.
- Elk Hollow is about two hours from Denver. The cabin has no Wi-Fi and has a wood stove; bring books.
- Maddie paid the $150 deposit. Leo owes her $75; this remained unpaid in the latest update on March 1.
- Leo is on breakfast duty and agreed to bring sourdough and the cast-iron pan Maddie gave him.
- Sam was unable to join the original February dates because of a conference; his availability for the rescheduled dates has not been stated.

## Upcoming dates and follow-ups
- Thursday after March 3: expected delivery of Maddie's green mug; receipt not yet confirmed.
- Saturday March 7: Alex Moreau's game night.
- March 12: Maddie's birthday; gift preference is wooden-handled pottery trimming tools.
- By March 13: Lakemont MEd admission decision expected.
- Saturday March 14, 2 pm: Alex and Hana's co-ed baby shower at Hana's parents' house in Evanston.
- March 15: Grace and Daniel's wedding RSVP deadline; check whether Leo and Sam have submitted their meal choices.
- March 27 to 29: Elk Hollow cabin trip; Leo owes Maddie $75 and is bringing breakfast supplies, sourdough, the cast-iron pan and books.
- April 18: Grace's bridal shower in Albuquerque, hosted by Maddie.
- April 19: Prairie Lights Half Marathon.
- April 20: Alex and Hana's baby girl is due.
- After the race in April: Leo and Sam plan to consider getting a dog, already provisionally named Pickle.
- May 16: Grace and Daniel's courtyard wedding at Casa Lumbre in Santa Fe.
- Outstanding possession: Maddie still has Leo's signed The Salt Orchard; return not confirmed.
